questions.question: Dr. Alami receives a refusal of coverage from the CNSS for an ALD patient. Dr. Mabrouki advises them to contest the decision. According to Article 24 of Law 65-00, what recourse is possible?
options: A friendly recourse with the CNSS
A contentious recourse before the court
A complaint to the order council
A request for revision by the ministry
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: 'The friendly recourse with the CNSS is the first step before any contentious recourse.' Dr. Alami: 'I will prepare the appeal file.'

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki has a civil servant patient who is wondering about the future of their AMO reimbursements. Dr. Alami informs them about Law 54.23. According to this law, what happens to agreements signed with mutual insurance companies?
options: They are immediately cancelled
They remain in force for a duration set by decree
They are automatically taken over by the CNSS
They become void on the date of promulgation
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: 'Agreements concluded with mutual insurance companies remain in force for a duration set by decree, to ensure a gradual transition.' Dr. Mabrouki: 'I will reassure my patient.'

questions.question: Dr. Alami has a patient who wants to have a ceramic-ceramic crown placed. Dr. Mabrouki informs them about the MGPAP reimbursement. According to recent developments, what is the additional flat-rate amount introduced by the MGPAP?
options: 160 DH per tooth
260 DH per tooth
360 DH per tooth
460 DH per tooth
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: 'The MGPAP has introduced an additional reimbursement of 360 DH per tooth for ceramic-ceramic crowns.' Dr. Alami: 'I will inform my patient of this amount.'

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki has a patient affiliated with the MGPAP. Dr. Alami asks them about the total reimbursement rate for medications. According to available information, what is this rate?
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: 'Members of the MGPAP benefit from a total reimbursement rate of 90% of the public price of the medication.' Dr. Mabrouki: 'I will inform my patient.'

questions.question: Dr. Alami has a non-salaried worker (TNS) patient. Dr. Mabrouki asks them to check their scheme. According to Law 65-00, what is the specific scheme for this category?
options: They are not entitled to the AMO
They fall under the AMO-TNS scheme
They must take out private insurance
They automatically benefit from RAMED
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: 'The AMO-TNS scheme is provided for self-employed workers, liberal professions, and other non-salaried activities.' Dr. Alami: 'I will check my patient's affiliation.'

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki has a 28-year-old student patient. Dr. Alami asks them how this patient can benefit from the AMO. According to Law 54.23, what is the situation?
options: Through the specific AMO-students scheme maintained
As a dependent of a primary insured person
They can no longer benefit from any AMO coverage
Through a special scheme for foreign students
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: 'Law 54.23 abolishes the specific AMO-students scheme. Students benefit from coverage as dependents.' Dr. Mabrouki: 'I will check the status of their insured parent.'

questions.question: Dr. Alami has a patient who had a workplace accident. Dr. Mabrouki asks them to check the coverage. According to Law 65-00, are workplace accidents covered by the AMO?
options: Yes, like all illnesses
No, they are governed by specific legislation
Yes, but only for civil servants
Partially, depending on severity
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: 'Risks related to workplace accidents remain governed by specific legislation, outside the scope of the AMO.' Dr. Alami: 'I will refer my patient to the CNSS for the workplace accident.'

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki has a patient who changed employers (from public to private). Dr. Alami asks them how the change of manager occurs. According to AMO rules, what is the procedure?
options: The patient must manually register with the CNSS
The transfer is automatic with coordination between bodies
The patient loses their coverage for 6 months
The patient must take out private insurance
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: 'Rules of coordination between managing bodies are provided in case of mobility between the public and private sectors.' Dr. Mabrouki: 'I will reassure my patient.'

questions.question: Dr. Alami has a patient who was hospitalized urgently abroad. Dr. Mabrouki advises them to check the reimbursement conditions. According to Article 13 of Law 65-00, under what condition are care abroad reimbursed?
options: If the patient is on a business trip
If the care cannot be provided in Morocco with prior agreement
If the patient is of Moroccan nationality
If the patient has subscribed to complementary insurance
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: 'Care abroad is reimbursed when care cannot be provided in Morocco, with prior agreement.' Dr. Alami: 'I will check if there was a prior agreement.'

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki has a patient who has subscribed to complementary insurance. Dr. Alami asks them to coordinate the reimbursements. According to general rules, how is the reimbursement distribution done?
options: The mutual insurance company reimburses 80%, the AMO the rest
The AMO reimburses 80%, the mutual insurance company covers the rest
The mutual insurance company reimburses 100% without AMO intervention
The patient chooses which body pays
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: 'The AMO reimburses 80% of the National Reference Tariff, then the complementary mutual insurance covers all or part of the co-payment.' Dr. Mabrouki: 'I will explain this operation to my patient.'

questions.question: Dr. Alami has a patient who has no AMO coverage and cannot pay their contributions. Dr. Mabrouki advises them on the options. According to Law 65-00, which scheme can they join?
options: The basic AMO scheme
The AMO-TADAMON scheme
A mandatory private insurance
No scheme, they must pay for their care
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: 'The AMO-TADAMON scheme is provided for people unable to pay their contributions, with the State covering the costs.' Dr. Alami: 'I will refer my patient to this scheme.'

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki has a patient who lost their insurance card. Dr. Alami advises them to check their registration number. According to Law 65-00, is registration with the AMO mandatory?
options: No, it remains optional
Yes, for any person exercising an activity
Yes, only for the public sector
No, except in the case of serious illness
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: 'The obligation of registration is the foundation of the AMO for any person exercising an activity.' Dr. Mabrouki: 'I will refer my patient to the CNSS.'

questions.question: Dr. Alami has a patient who wants teeth whitening. Dr. Mabrouki reminds them of the rules. According to Law 65-00, is whitening covered by the AMO?
options: Yes, at 80%
No, because it is a cosmetic procedure
Yes, if the dentist prescribes it
Partially depending on the mutual insurance company
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: 'Teeth whitening being a cosmetic procedure, it is excluded from the scope of benefits guaranteed by the AMO.' Dr. Alami: 'I will inform my patient of this exclusion.'

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki has a patient who received an undue reimbursement. Dr. Alami advises them to report the error. According to Article 135 of Law 65-00, what risk does a person who improperly obtains benefits face?
options: A fine of 1,000 to 5,000 dirhams
A prison sentence of 6 months
Suspension of their rights
A simple warning
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: 'Article 135 punishes fraud or false declaration with a fine of 1,000 to 5,000 dirhams.' Dr. Mabrouki: 'I will report the error to the CNSS.'

questions.question: Dr. Alami has a patient affiliated with the MGPAP. Dr. Mabrouki asks them about the particularities of this mutual insurance company. According to available information, what is the total reimbursement rate for consultations?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: 'Members of the MGPAP benefit from a total reimbursement rate of 90% for consultations.' Dr. Alami: 'I will inform my patient.'

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki has a patient who wants aesthetic veneers. Dr. Alami reminds them of the rules. According to Law 65-00, how are these procedures covered?
options: At 80% like current care
They are excluded from the scope of the AMO
At 100% if the dentist prescribes them
Partially depending on the mutual insurance company
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: 'Aesthetic veneers are excluded from the scope of the AMO as cosmetic procedures.' Dr. Mabrouki: 'I will inform my patient of this exclusion.'

questions.question: Dr. Alami has a patient who changed their family situation. Dr. Mabrouki advises them to update the file. According to Article 5 of Law 65-00, who are the dependents covered by the AMO?
options: Only the spouse
The spouse, children under 21, and disabled children
Children only up to age 18
All ascendants without age limit
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: 'Article 5 defines dependents as: the spouse, children under 21 (26/30 years for students), and disabled children without age limit.' Dr. Alami: 'I will update the file.'

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki has a patient who has exceeded the deadline for submitting invoices. Dr. Alami asks them to check the deadline. According to AMO rules, what is the maximum deadline for submitting a reimbursement request?
options: 15 days
30 days
60 days
6 months
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: 'Documents must be submitted within 60 days following the date of care.' Dr. Mabrouki: 'I will remind my patient to submit their invoices quickly.'

questions.question: Dr. Alami has a foreign student patient. Dr. Mabrouki asks them to check their coverage. According to Law 54.23, how are foreign students covered?
options: They are not entitled to the AMO
They benefit from the AMO through an agreement with the authorities
They must take out private insurance
They are excluded from the Moroccan health system
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: 'Foreign students benefit from the AMO under an agreement between the CNSS and the relevant authorities.' Dr. Alami: 'I will reassure my patient.'

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki has a patient with a disabled child. Dr. Alami asks them about the coverage. According to Law 65-00, how is a disabled child covered by the AMO?
options: Only up to age 21
Up to age 26
Without age limit
Up to age 30
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: 'Dependent disabled children benefit from AMO coverage without age limit.' Dr. Mabrouki: 'I will inform my patient of this right.'

questions.question: Dr. Alami has a patient who wants to get a dental implant. Dr. Mabrouki informs them about coverage. According to general rules, what is the situation?
options: The AMO reimburses the implant at 80%
The implant is not covered by the AMO
All mutual insurance companies reimburse implants
The State covers the full cost
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: 'The AMO does not cover dental implants. Some mutual insurance companies may offer coverage.' Dr. Alami: 'I will refer my patient to their mutual insurance company.'

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki has a patient who was hospitalized. Dr. Alami asks them to check the coverage. According to Article 7 of Law 65-00, what types of care are guaranteed by the AMO?
options: Only curative care
Curative, preventive, rehabilitation, maternity, and dental care
Only cosmetic care
Exclusively medications
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: 'Article 7 lists preventive, curative, rehabilitation, maternity, dental care, etc.' Dr. Mabrouki: 'I will check the full coverage.'

questions.question: Dr. Alami has a patient who benefits from RAMED. Dr. Mabrouki asks them to check the conditions. According to Article 3 of Law 65-00, who is RAMED intended for?
options: Economically disadvantaged people not subject to the AMO
Civil servants and State agents
Self-employed liberal workers
Higher education students
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: 'RAMED is intended for economically disadvantaged people who do not benefit from any AMO scheme.' Dr. Alami: 'I will check if my patient meets the conditions.'

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki has a patient who changed status (from employee to self-employed). Dr. Alami asks them to check their affiliation. According to Law 65-00, which scheme must they join?
options: The basic AMO scheme
The AMO-TNS scheme
The RAMED scheme
No scheme, they must take out private insurance
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: 'Self-employed workers fall under the AMO-TNS scheme.' Dr. Mabrouki: 'I will refer my patient to the AMO-TNS.'

questions.question: Dr. Alami, after having handled several coverage disputes with Dr. Mabrouki, receives their congratulations. What is the next step for Dr. Alami?
options: Become an expert in mutual insurance disputes
Retire
Change specialty
Forget good practices
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: 'Mastery of disputes is a valuable skill. Becoming an expert is the next step.' Dr. Alami: 'I will train in appeals management.'
